messages:
maria: quick one — noticed the model card for ZephyrXL has a broken markdown anchor in the 'limits' section. catalog links to /models/zephyrxl#limits but the card heading is '## Sequence limits' so anchor is #sequence-limits. small but customer-facing.
aj: is this a link typo on the catalog index or the card?
maria: the index links to /models/zephyrxl#limits. the model card has '## Sequence limits'. also the SDK snippet under 'long-context tips' uses the old v1 call pattern — should update both.
sam: paste the snippet you want to replace and I can open a quick PR.
maria: old snippet:
```python3
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate("Summarize: ...", max_tokens=512)
print(resp.text)
```
proposed new snippet (v2):
```python3
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.responses.create(model="zephyr-xl", input="Summarize: ...", max_output_tokens=512)
# print raw response element
print(resp.output[0].content)
```
leo: recommend adding an id shim so old external links keep working. our renderer supports `{#id}` so add `### Limits {#limits}` below the sequence limits header.
aj: agree. also include a one-sentence note about quantized variants having reduced effective context.
maria: suggested wording: 'Note: Quantized 8-bit variants may exhibit reduced effective context; for stable long-sequence workloads prefer full-precision variants or our recommended chunking strategy.'
jen: mkdocs handles `{#limits}` syntax. I'll add it in the PR.
sam: opened draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4620 — fixes catalog link, adds `### Limits {#limits}` and replaces the SDK snippet. PTAL.
docbot: PR opened by sam: #4620 — CI checks running.
leo: lint flagged code blocks require `python3` label and line length on example.
sam: fixed lint, pushed. preview: https://deploy-preview-4620--docs.redwood.ai/models/zephyrxl
jen: QA: double-check the example uses the correct response field. our SDK exposes helper `output_text` but raw shape is `output` list. prefer using raw field.
aj: use `resp.output[0].content` in snippet to match raw shape. add a short comment about helper props.
maria: updated snippet and added frontmatter changelog line 'snippet: migrated to responses API (sdk v2)'. pushed.
docbot: PR merged by sam — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4620 — CI: passed, deployed to staging.
jen: can we add a redirect for old anchor to avoid 404s from external posts?
leo: added a tiny redirect in follow-up PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4621 — mapping /models/zephyrxl#limits -> /models/zephyrxl#sequence-limits.
maria: added a task on docs-ship board to draft an SDK migration note. @aj will take migration blurb.
aj: will draft short migration guidance and include example mappings for generate -> responses. thanks!
